Players Committee card image of [[Green Leader In Green Squadron 1 (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Permanent pilot is •Green Leader, who provides ability of 2. Adds one battle destiny with a Rebel snub fighter. During battle, may cancel immunity to attrition of one starship here; this A-wing is 'hit.'”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/greenleaderingreensquadron1.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3d6a28de79744f577eda610c619c9f6723ba7042 3d6a28d] (11 February 2019). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
